feature_name: VMware Aria Operations for Logs integration
summary: VMware Aria Operations for Logs integration lets you collect and manage logs from VMware Engine and on-premises environments in a centralized solution.
extended_definition: VMware Aria Operations for Logs integration lets you collect and manage logs from VMware Engine and on-premises environments in a centralized solution.

supporting_pages.title: "Best practices for VMware Engine security \_|\_ Google Cloud VMware Engine\
evidence_snippets: Ingest VMware Engine logs and metrics Many organizations want to collect and analyze logs in a centralized "Single Pane of Glass." In Google Cloud, the Cloud Logging and Cloud Monitoring products provide services which can be used for centralized management of logs and metrics.
As a best practice, align the approach for collecting and analyzing logs for workload VMs on VMware Engine with the approach for Compute Engine instances and your on-premises estate (if applicable).
To collect platform logs, VMware Engine private clouds can forward Syslog logs to a centralized log aggregator.
